subject.title: fix(browser): tab creation steals window focus during agent automation

question: Should OpenClaw’s extension relay intentionally override CDP’s omitted `Target.createTarget` foreground default so automation-created tabs open in the background?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but the central relay change is a deliberate compatibility policy for all omitted-parameter CDP consumers rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt background automation default
options.body: Approve the OpenClaw-specific omitted-parameter policy, refresh the branch, and retain the explicit CDP compatibility tests before merge.

options.title: Preserve raw CDP default
options.body: Keep omitted relay requests foreground-compatible and redesign the OpenClaw or Playwright caller boundary to request background creation explicitly.

recommendation.title: Adopt background automation default
recommendation.body: Approve the OpenClaw-specific omitted-parameter policy, refresh the branch, and retain the explicit CDP compatibility tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history places this person closest to intentional browser activation and focus policy in the same CDP module.
